title: Poppler 0.76.1 through 26.11.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SplashOutputDev::iccTransform() that allows…
description: Poppler versions 0.76.1 through 26.11.0 contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the SplashOutputDev::iccTransform() function. This flaw occurs when rendering PDFs with ICCBased images whose alternate color space is DeviceN, leading to an out-of-bounds write in the per-row buffer. Exploitation can cause renderer crashes and heap memory corruption.
